rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual way to describe an aimless wander or a trip with no particular destination.

example.english: On days off, I like to roam around the outlying islands without planning where to go.
example.traditional: 放假我鍾意去離島周圍行吓，唔使諗住去邊。
